round1.resolution: All ten findings repaired; default/multiple streams, callback/slot owners, partial notification cancellation, closing guards, SHM rollback and group cleanup/depth tested. All new locks use pthread. Transport retirement retains failed runner scratch. No generic core work records or tracker tail events restored.

round2.resolution: Five findings repaired; five added core regression cases passed in both transport variants. Host-MPI2/4 ranks and performance target validated; full script result and final native verdict tracked in external reports.

round3.resolution: Removed fused device-wide cleanup fallback; retained failed preparation stream drain and progress; cached semaphore completion proof before partial event destruction. Four new core cases passed in both builds. See external reports for final native verdict.

round4.resolution: C2C stream creation and SHM attachment outputs written into retained owners before checking status. Actual C2C planner retry regression and real setupIpcBarriers body under partial-output failure both pass.

round5.resolution: Transport retirement gates Finalize/public deregistration. Callback references and existing owned events replace asynchronous borrowed stream queries. Failure-only GPU prefix proof is captured while the launch stream is valid; no host tail event. Six new core cases pass per build; full rebuilt matrices pass.

round6.resolution: Converge native catalog/registration preparation before SDK collective close; save per-owner preparation. Drain rejected standalone group owners before readiness; keep standalone data admission closed across retry, preserving Get event ownership. Three core and one real-bootstrap cases added; all rebuilt host matrices and2/4-rank runs passed.

round7.resolution: Advance pending Finalize through public async-error polling so the unchanged NCCL wrapper can finish. Preserve cached device ordinal for active SDKs without device queries. Four core regressions pass in both builds; all2/4-rank bootstrap lifecycle cases pass.

round8.resolution: Finish earlier native owner progress before next collective close; keep final owner pollable. Restore Barrier checked execution and retryable private scratch. User-directed strict macro removal uses CHECK/GOTO and explicit Progress owner gates. Eleven core regressions and two bootstrap cases added; full force-rebuilt matrices and2/4-rank runs passed.
